description: FactoryRegistry Research publishes a fixed third-quarter 2026 snapshot of United States manufacturing facility counts by state, county and NAICS subsector. Zenodo lists public CSV tables, a README and a Frictionless datapackage under CC BY 4.0. The provider reports 262,554 listed facilities across 3,061 counties, of which 113,815 have a recent operating signal, using EPA, OSHA and other federal records. State coverage is compared with BLS QCEW establishment counts; tables also describe employment bands and top counties or industries. These aggregates can inform regional industrial-load or logistics-demand scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this edition. A limitation is that Zenodo exposes summary tables, not all facility-level rows, so it cannot directly geolocate each plant. Listing is not proof of current operation, and QCEW and the register use different inclusion rules. The README documents source and activity rules, but counts were not independently reconciled. No CSV was downloaded.
